The affix क्विप्‌ comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time when the following words in the Accusative -2nd case ae in composition - 1. भ्रूण 'a foetus' 2. वृत्र ।

Terms: क्विप्‌

The affix यन् is added in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the words 1. ब्राह्मण 2. माणव and वाडव ।

Terms: यन्

The affix त्व comes in the sense of of 'nature or action thereof' after the word ब्रह्मण denoting a kind of होत्रा priest.

Terms: त्व

The words ब्राह्मण and उष्णिक are anomalous when they are a Name.

Terms: Anomalous

The affix अच् comes after the word वर्चस् when preceded in a compound by the words ब्रह्म or हस्ति।

Terms: अच्

The affix टच् comes after the word ब्रह्मण in a तत्-पुरुष समास when the compound denotes a person belonging to a certain country.

Terms: टच्

ब्राह्म is irregularly formed from ब्रह्मन् when not meaning 'a kind of जाति'.

Terms: प्रकृति भाव
